issues.where: foreground soil mound across the lower half of the frame (also in set-C-04.png and set-C-07.png)
issues.what: the soil clods read as glossy, sharp-faceted obsidian or crumpled metallic plastic with harsh specular highlights and blue-black fill instead of porous, crumbly damp earth
issues.fix: replace the faceted glossy displacement shader with granular, matte-rough organic soil geometry containing fine crumbs, pores, root fibers, and diffused wet micro-roughness

issues.where: grass blades and dew drops along the left edge (also in set-C-01.png, set-C-06.png, set-C-07.png, and set-C-09.png)
issues.what: the grass blades are flat, ruler-straight green cards with a single painted margin stripe, and rigid glass-marble spheres stick sideways onto vertical edges and balance off needle-thin tips without gravity sag or wetting
issues.fix: add thickness, subtle curl, parallel fibrous venation, and fine edge serrations to the grass blades, and deform dew drops with gravity teardrops, proper contact angles, and wet surface menisci

issues.where: crop 1, open top rim of the sunflower seed hull where the green stem enters (also in set-C-08.png crop 1)
issues.what: the green stem cylinder clips directly through the yellow-green cotyledon and dark hull opening with an unshaded geometric intersection line, while the hull rim shows stair-stepped polygonal notches and transverse polygon ring bands under painted stripes
issues.fix: subdivide and sculpt fibrous split edges on the seed hull rim, model true physical clearance and contact cavity shading around the emerging cotyledons and stem, and add micro-displacement to the hull stripes

issues.where: crop 1, center depression of the soil mound where the sprout will emerge (and inner left cavity wall in set-C-08.png crop 5)
issues.what: the animated soil crack geometry is squashed and pulled into smeared, stretched glossy brown polygon ribbons
issues.fix: use discrete rigid/granular clod simulation or rest-pose world-space triplanar displacement instead of stretching a single continuous mesh across the opening seam

issues.where: crop 1, seed hull next to the curved stem hook
issues.what: the body of the seed hull becomes heavily blurred inside the sharp zone while the adjacent stem hook and the top hull intersection rim millimeters away remain tack-sharp
issues.fix: keep a physically consistent macro focal plane and motion-blur velocity across the entire seed head and upper stem hook

issues.where: crop 5, base of the stem where it meets the soil (also in set-C-08.png crop 5)
issues.what: the backlit lower stem stays evenly bright right down to the hard edge of the foreground clod with no contact shadow, ambient occlusion, or clinging wet fine soil collar
issues.fix: add ambient occlusion, light attenuation into the soil cavity, and damp fine soil grains clinging around the stem emergence base

issues.where: crop 2, dark soil crumbs along the stem and air to the left of the stem (also in set-C-08.png crops 1 and 2)
issues.what: isolated angular rock-like polygons perch cleanly on the stem silhouette with no moisture meniscus or surrounding fine dust, and a stray dark speck floats detached in mid-air to the left of the stem alongside faint vertical stamp streaks
issues.fix: seat irregular damp soil clusters onto the stem with wet menisci and fine dust trails, and remove floating detached particles

issues.where: crop 2, stem surface and silhouetted stem hairs (also in set-C-08.png crops 1 and 2)
issues.what: the stem is a smooth, featureless cylindrical gradient tube whose hairs read as uniform, evenly spaced stubby rim spikes and single-pixel white speckles across the front face and upper hook
issues.fix: add longitudinal cellular striations and organic surface unevenness to the hypocotyl, and vary trichome length, bend, clumping, and anti-aliased subpixel thickness

issues.where: crop 6 and crop 1, tiny moisture droplets across the soil clods (and grass dew highlights in set-C-09.png crops 7 and 8)
issues.what: moisture on the soil consists of tiny isolated glass spheres perched dryly atop dark facets, with a few beads floating above clod tips in crop 1, and bright specular highlights on grass dew drops show blocky pixel stair-stepping
issues.fix: replace isolated spherical beads on soil with continuous damp darkening and settled micro-films in crevices, ground all droplets onto geometry, and anti-alias specular fireflies

issues.where: crop 9, lower half of the blurred sun disc across the horizon (also in set-C-06.png crop 9 and set-C-09.png crop 9)
issues.what: evenly spaced, straight radial starburst streaks fan downward from the out-of-focus sun like a 2D post-process ray filter, contradicting the wide-open macro depth of field
issues.fix: remove the artificial radial spoke overlay and render natural wide-aperture optical bloom and soft atmospheric scatter around the sun
